LESSON: FREE-HAND SKETCHING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Free-hand sketching

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Free-hand sketching. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: FREE-HAND SKETCHING
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Free-hand sketching helps you succeed in PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

KEY FACTS: FREE-HAND SKETCHING
Study Free-hand sketching like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching

What this means
In this part you learn to Explain the principles of free-hand sketching. You will use ideas from in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching.
2. Plan safely, do the steps, then check using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Safety first: State one safety rule before practising “Free-hand sketching”.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Explain the principles of free-hand sketching. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

What this means
In this part you learn to Identify techniques of free-hand sketching. You will use ideas from in the workshop corner, classroom, or a safe practice space.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching.
2. Plan safely, do the steps, then check using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Steps: List 3 correct steps to complete a simple task on Free-hand sketching.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Identify techniques of free-hand sketching. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Free-hand sketching is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: State one safety rule before practising “Free-hand sketching”. (skill: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching)

Example 2: List 3 correct steps to complete a simple task on Free-hand sketching. (skill: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Free-hand sketching to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching.
3. Practise this skill: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Free-hand sketching from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Free-hand sketching: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Free-hand sketching?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Free-hand sketching means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Explain the principles of free-hand sketching.
5. Be able to: Identify techniques of free-hand sketching.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
